nom: Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum Dark Spot Corrector

avis.texte: I have spent so much money on fading my spots on my arms and legs nothing help. My dermatologist recommended this product and it has changed my life. it's pricey, but worth it.
Radiant-tone-dual-serum-dark-spot-corrector is an awesome product!!!

avis.titre: I see a difference and LIKE the fragrance!
avis.texte: I'm a bit of a product junkie and am also sensitive to scents meaning I can be hard to please. I've spent $$$ over the years for Vitamin C products to supposedly brighten dark spots and they either don't work, have too much silicone for my skin, or smell like hotdogs. This product has a light, feminine scent that I actually associate with luxury skincare, glides on without a silicone base, and in 3 weeks, I see a noticeable in difference in my skin! You do have to commit to sunscreen, and it tingles a bit (I apply right after showering), but I am impressed, especially at this price point. As soon as I finish my current sunscreen, I am going to try the lotion with sunscreen and see how using two of the thiamidol products together works!

I keep coming back to this serum; it fades existing dark marks and helps prevent new ones. I like that it doesn't interact with the other products in my routine either. I use 1-2 pumps, and this is one of the only products that I've noticed a considerable difference with. I also like the texture. The secret is the thiamadol ingredient, which makes sense since it's backed by research. This ingredient is newer to the states i rhink and I'm surprised more people aren't talking about it! I'd skip the other products in the line, this one is the best.

I have brown skin and am prone to hyperpigmentation. I have some stubborn marks on my face and have been using this lotion for 2 weeks. I certainly see some lightening but I will give it a few more weeks before the final verdict.
I want to keep using it, but the fragrance is way too strong and irritates my nose. Please make a fragrance-free version!

I love this product! Over the years I have used many spot corrector products, but unfortuately none of them worked. When I read about this product, I decided to try it and WOW! it really worked great for me!! Give it a try, you will not be disappointed, and you will not be throwing away your money on something that doesn't work - because it does!! This product is also very reasonably priced!! To finish out this purchase, I bought the full radient tone face lotion with SPF for the day and the radient tone night cream for bedtime. All 3 are awesome!!

Every Thiamidol product I've seen has a heavy fragrance. Why? Maybe thiamidol smells bad. Idk but I love everything about this product except for the fragrance. It doesn't irrrirate my skin but i wish it was fragrance free.

…after using daily, two pumps at a time for a month or so, it's already gone?? I'm sure there's probably plenty left in the bottle, but you can't see through it sooo….? Makes no sense to buy this again. Sad.

avis.titre: No improvement, seems to cause breakouts
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for about four weeks now and I haven't seen any improvement in my melasma whatsoever. It actually seems like it might be slightly darker, though I figured that had to do with it being summertime (though I wear sunscreen daily). I've had a lot of breakouts since I started using it and some whiteheads or milia (still trying to figure out which). I don't usually have issues with acne. It's a good price point and the texture is nice, but it doesn't seem to be doing much except breaking me out.

avis.titre: I like it and think it's working
avis.texte: There is not very much information about this product so I was hesitant to buy... Because I usually get Eucerin products as a fail safe, I decided to give it a chance. This product is not as strong as hydroquinone, but I would avoid using it with a retinoid or AHA (made my skin peel). I do regularly use a gentle BHA cleanser (I have combination skin) and haven't noticed any adverse effects. Many have complained of the scent, but I don't mind it much--reminds me of a La Prairie serum I once had lol. I pair this with a ceramide moisturizer and use 2 daily. My skin DOES look more radiant, but due to some pre-existing pigmentation issues (I am medium-toned) I want to wait until I've used it for a while longer (it's only been about a month) before assessing it's skin "correcting" properties. Other than the brief issue with the actives, I haven't experienced other problems. Be sure to wear your sunscreen, too!

The bottle shows 1oz of product. Each pump only contains around 0.2ml which should come out at around 120-150 pumps but the bottles I got only reached 80 pumps average. And of course you can't see the product through the bottle. Very sneaky!

I am absolutely impressed and in love with this line! I have been using the radiant tone eye cream, serum and night cream for 2 weeks and I have noticed a visible difference! I wake up in the morning and my skin is so smooth and beautiful! I have never had anything make my skin feel and look this nice! Even my high end luxury moisturizers! I love everything about it great price and I love the packaging! I was shocked when I seen the reviews about the scent! What?! It has a very very faint cream smell. I will always repurchase and recommend! I never want to be without
The scent is horrible! So many people are sensitive to fragrance, why put it in? It does not make a more pleasant experience like you say. You don't even list it in the ingredients.

I purchased this before reading the reviews and almost returned the product because of all the negativity about the fragrance. I was terrified this was going to be a similar experience to self tanners and was afraid to open the packaging. What a shock to discover there is barely any noticeable scent. I have a lot of old freckles and age spots that.i am hoping to lighten up with this product. I will report back in a few months.
This was recommended by my dermatologist but the fragrance is so overpowering. This really needs to be reformulated in a fragrance free version.
My dermatologist recommended using this product and I have to say I've been using it for a week and I can actually see a difference.

I understand a lot of people do not like the scented version of this serum and I understand that some may have allergies, asthma or other issues that trigger health related symptoms. I almost always read the ingredients before I purchase a product and it does list fragrance as an ingredient. As for myself I love the way it smells. It's mild, feminine and light. I cannot wait to see the results.
Smells great, but after two weeks it's hard to tell if it is working!

avis.titre: Wonderful product. Really made a visible difference.
avis.texte: I've been using the Eucerin Cleansing Gel, Dual Serum, Night Cream, Daily Lotion 30 and Eye Cream and am very happy with the results. Not so much with the eye cream, still puffy. Overheard my buddies at breakfast a couple of weeks saying how good I look

I wanted this to work so badly but unfortunately the fragrance is causing me to break out and it also pills when combined with other products. Please make a fragrance free version for acne prone skin.

It's a good product, my skin is better, I have a few days using that and I really love it, someone recommended me and I think that is the best that I bought it. And when my product is finish Im gonna buy again, I promise, thank you for having me thanks
I became nauseous and developed a headache after the first time I applied this on my skin. I'm seeing a lot of other people complaining about the smell as well. Please make a fragrance-free version.
It didn't help me at all, on the contrary, it brought out more dark spots. I don't recommend it at all.
After using for one week, I can see lightening of dark spots, but like others, the fragrance is nauseating
I ordered this product just a week ago and I've already noticed a change in my skin; my complexion is more even. It's very good!

Fitzpatrick Scale 1, early 30's, normal/oily skin-type. I've developed melasma on the tops of my cheeks as well as a few spots on my cheeks triggered by birth control. It has a serum/milky texture and it feels moisturizing. I've been using this mainly in the evening as this makes my SPF pill. I do find this effective, in two weeks I have seen noticible fading in my melasma. I will preface my melasma looks about one to two foundation shades darker than my skintone. This does have a strong floral scent which dissipates after like ten minutes (or maybe I just don't notice it after that). Overall I would say this is effective.

I loveee Eucerin products- they're the only things that have saved me from my horrific eczema. My dermatologist recommended I try this serum for hyperpigmentation. I've used it twice so far and I am breaking out wicked and I can't help but think it's from the fragrance... Please make a fragrance-free version!

As a company that is a common go-to for many with sensitive skin, I am shocked by the fragrance in this serum. It is STRONG and BAD. I can't describe the smell - I wish I could - it is just incredibly off-putting immediately. I had to wash it off. Almost...sour? I really just can't believe they would add something so strong, much less so nauseating, to a Eucerin product. Even if I loved strong perfumes, this one just smells...BAD!
Worked at first. When i was satisfied i stopped using it and pigmentation came back even darker.

I've been using this serum most days to help reduce my melasma. I have been using it for about 2 weeks, no real results yet, but I'm hoping with consistent use over the next couple of months, it will help. It is fragranced, which is quite strong and not ideal. However, this was recommended by dermatologists, so I am hoping to see results in the near future.
Wanted to love. Been using Eucerin products for decades. Rely on them for fragrance free products, friendly for sensitive skin. This was way too irritating.
This might be an effective product, can't say because the fragrance is so strong and it irritates and burns my face so badly I can't consistently use it
I would love a fragrance free alternative for this product. Thank you.

avis.titre: Pretty much the only thing that's worked for me
avis.texte: I'm 46 and have suffered from melasma/hyperpigmentation forever. I've tried Vit C's, a trendy prescription based hydroquinone product (increased my hyperpigmentation when I stopped!), lasers, other serums, etc. Didn't put much faith into this product. However, before my first bottles of the serum and day moisturizer were out, I could tell a remarkable difference in my face. Went to my med spa doc who immediately asked what I had been using on my face (she knows my hyperpigmentation well). She's commented twice, now, about the improvement. I only give 4/5 stars, however, b/c it seems I've kinda plateaued with the results? I can live like this and be happy, but I still have more spots/dark areas than I'd like. I'm almost done with my second bottle of the serum and 3rd bottle of the day moisturizer. Maybe it's still working gradually, but I can promise the initial results were pretty dramatic. I hope they NEVER stop making this product. It has permanent residence in my arsenal.
Love the product, works on hyperpigmentation. Will repurchase.

I almost fell in love with this product. I am not at all bothered by the fragrance or the alcohol denatured. It's a luxurious texture that feels moisturizing on the skin. However, after trying many tried and true anti-pilling techniques, it's just not a team player. It makes my sunscreens pill. It pills after my vit c. In the evening it makes my moisturizer and milky toners pill. I'm not over applying, rubbing too hard, and I'm waiting for dry down between layers. Unfortunately it's just too finicky to easily use. I haven't been able to use it long enough to say whether it's effective at reducing hyperpigmentation. It just doesn't want to sit properly on my face. I can't return it now so I'll just use the rest on my body.
The perfume in this is too strong. Such a pity. I will not be buying this anymore. The spot treatment smells fine, why can't they make a fragrance free version for the whole face?
Did nothing to lighten my dark spots. If anything, the hyperpigmentation got darker. Smells like alcohol

avis.titre: Works. Halts hyperpigmentation in its tracks
avis.texte: I was skeptical but this seems to work. I use hyperpigmentation products reguarly so I don't habe many spots but I have randomly been having more than usual breakouts and my issues with those is whether you pick at them or not, they still scar. I have been using 2 thiamidol products from this line and what I notice is that this works great on fresh hyperpigmentation in the sense that a healing pimple will not really start to darken compared to the way it would if I wasn't using this. It tingles and used to heat up my face the first few weeks of use and irritated around my eyes which is odd because I don't have sensitive skin but the eventually stopped. It is heavely fragranced. It almost feels like you are putting a hair product on your face.

avis.titre: Please make a fragrance free version
avis.texte: Great serum however the fragrance is STRONG and pretty awful. It smells like old tomey perfume. I'm not even particularly sensitive to smells and it really bothers me. The fragrance lingers well after the serum has absorbed into the skin, too. If it wasnt for the fragrance, this would be a 5/5 product.
It does the job but the fragrance is too overpowering. Can you please make a fragrance free version??

This is the only product I've tried that actually reduces the appearance of my dark, melasma spots! I've even tried prescription products and they don't come close to this dual serum. I'm going to be using this for a long time! Worth the price!!
Please reformulate to remove the scent, and then I would love to use this product. The night cream is worse than the day cream.

I was excited to try this product ljbe after reading reviews. I used it twice daily for 6 weeks and in that time i did not notice any change in my hyperpigmentation. I stopped using it ultimately because it was clogging my pores abd causing breakouts.
I love Eucerin and wanted this to work but the smell is WAY to strong it was giving me a headache. Had to return it after 2 days. There should be no scent in face cream. Disappointed.
Warning. If U offers a free gift with purchase, they will not honor it and make you pay to return.
i purchased this for brown spots on the back of my hands. I have been using since July and my spots are virtually all gone. Amazing. I will continue to buy and use on any other spots on my arms etc.

avis.titre: Smells great, works great (and derm recommended)
avis.texte: Saw a dermatologist recommend this as a handful of far less expensive drugstore brands and wanted to try it. Less than a month in, but daily use, and I'm impressed. Smells great, seems to work great. Zero irritation for my sensitive skin.
You have to apply this four times a day good luck with this over the counter garbage

I've used almost a whole bottle of the Radiant Tone Dual Serum and my age spots/sun damage have actually faded. They aren't gone, but they are lighter. This is the first serum I've found that has made a noticeable difference. Yes, I will buy it again.

I have trusted Eucerin and enjoyed many of their products before. I was excited to try this product as an alternative to hydroquinone. Unfortunately they ruined it with the addition of a strong fragrance. I find it nauseating, it gives me a headache, and also irritates my skin.
It works great. Keeps my melasma under control. I use it morning at night. Works great under makeup as long as you use a small amount. At night, I use more.
Was hoping that fragrance as last ingredient would be fine, but it is too strong. Make it fragrance free!
My dermatologist gave this to me as a sample and I used it and immediately bought it to make sure I had it on hand before I ran out

This works. I started out using the serum twice daily and could notice a difference at 2 weeks. Now I use it only at night and it's still improving and maintaining brighter looking skin. The fragrance is overpowering though. If it can be lessened or eliminated, this product would be perfect.

I started noticing a reduction in pigmentation almost immediately after starting this but almost abandoned it because of the heavy fragrance. It does irritate my skin but doesn't usually cause problems. It is more perfumed than most perfume. I will continue to use it but I BEG of Eucerin to please release a fragrance free version or at least reduce the amount of fragrance used. I don't care how bad thiamidol smells. The people need this!

I would love for Eucerin to release a product containing thiamidol which does not have alcohol denat and parfum. Those of us with sensitive skin would love to be able to use thiamidol products, but are concerned given the ingredient list. Generally Eucerin products are so much friendlier for sensitive skin.
Love this product but the fragrance is way too strong. Please make a fragrance free products!
This works so good for dry sensitive skin. I use it in combination with .05 tret. It was recommended to me directly by my derm and I love it.

I've been using this product for a full month now and I have noticed a difference. The only problem I have is that it does break me out from time to time. I would just recommend that you use this with vitamin c too, it also helps with the process.
The product feels nice as in texture, but you can smell the alcohol and I have sensitive skin and don't prefer to put that much alcohol on my face.

Been using this for about a month, not sure if it's working yet. Being hopeful. But please can you guys remove the fragrance, I feel like it's contributing to wrinkles. I would love to continue using but may have to stop as the fragrance is getting to me.

avis.titre: Need to use it for long term
avis.texte: i have combination skin. In the summer it's getting more oily on my forehead and nose. I purchased this serum on April 30, so it's about 3 months using. My forehead and my nose have allergic reaction with this but it works just fine on my cheeks (dry area). I noticed dark spot because of acne gets lighter but very slow. For people are allegic with Niaciamide, vitamin C and tranexamic acid, this is a good option for treating dark spots
I have been using this for about 1.5 months. I do see a little fading of some spots, but the serum gives me pimples.

avis.titre: I wouldn't recommend it at all
avis.texte: Though I love eucerin tinted age defense and it's the product that made me think to use the bright collection but that was the worst decision I bought the dual serum and the eye cream it was fine at the first week but I noticed my pores started to be more visible to me though I never had any issues with it my whole life and I started seeing brown circles under my eyes after using the eye cream and all over I had ugly skin tone and discolouration though I used it only at night I stopped using it was so upset it really ruined my skin texture and colour

This product was recommended by my dermatologist to lighten some age spots on my hands. After a few weeks ( approximately 2) the spots started to fade and are clearly lighter ( yay!). I've also used on my face and see an improvement in my complexion. I am hyper-sensitive to certain scents but find this product's fragrance rather pleasant, light, and non-offensive.

avis.titre: I bought this product in May and now July
avis.texte: I have used this product for 2 half months and I see a big difference in my dark spots they are lighter now instead of them being dark. This product works for me just needs patience and the whole facial skin care products for it to work.

I was so excited to hear about this product as I have been struggling with melasma and was looking for new things to try. Unfortunately it is strongly fragranced, which I did not realize until I had opened the package. Since I can't return it to the store I am trying it but will likely discontinue due to fragrance, which triggers migraines for me. Please make an unfragranced version so that those of us with sensitivities and allergies and use it too!
I love this serum but I'm begging you to make a fragrance free version of it. The fragrance is way too strong.
Hard to believe people who rave when all they had was a sample.Smells awful.

This has been a game-changer for me! I have tried so many different products, facials, peels etc. to try and even our my skin tone over the past few years. Within weeks ive seen a noticeable difference and I'm so happy! Great price point for such an amazing product, I'm thrilled with the results so far and going to check out the rest of the line!

This has been a game-changer for me! I have tried so many different products, facials, peels etc. to try and even our my skin tone over the past few years. Within weeks ive seen a noticeable difference and I'm so happy! Great price point for such an amazing product, I'm thrilled with the results so far and going to check out the rest of the line!

I received the eucerin serum for free, and have tried this serum for a month. I noticed my skin feels better, but I'm not sure that my dark marks are lighter. My skin is smooth and has a more even tone, but hasn't necessarily cleared the dark marks. Be warned that there is a bit of slight stinging after application.
This product works so well, better than any other cream I have tried.
The Eucerin Radiant tone dual serum absorbed into the skin wonderfully, it plumps and hydrates I noticed that the tone and texture of my skin improved within two weeks of use!

I gave this 3 stars because i was told it worked fine ,I read the fine print and it did not recommend people who have a sun sensitive to use it ,and unfortunately i fall in to the catorgory of people with that sensitivity so unfortunately i wasnt ablr to actually use the product .
This serum is spot on at evening out my skin tone! I love this!!!! I want the bottle to last forever! Perfection in a bottle!

I have enjoyed using this serum in my skincare steps. It helps keep my face moisturized and I have not had any new black spots pop up since using it. I do find that if I rub my eyes (after it has dried!) that my eyes sting. That is the one thing I don't like, but I shouldn't touch my face anyway. It has lessen some of the dark spots I have but it gives my skin an amazing glow.
The outer bottle esthetic is clean, crisp and offers spa-like similarity to high end brands packaging designs.

I sought out this product after being recommended by my determaologist. I received a trial from my doctor's office of the serum, day and night lotion. I loved the texture and quick absorption. I didn't mind the scent, however I did find I strong. I saw results quickly and ordered the whole set in full size. The results were impressive, unfortunately my sensitive skin reacted immediately in breakouts from the serum. I will likely be returning until another version becomes available for sensitive skin. I will be hesitant to recommend to others after my experience.

So i am a dark person and a senior , i used this for my dark patches left from post facial laser therapy from stone&hand massage some yrs back. After Ecerine serum use my skin became darker after 2 days of use. Not for me . I love the smell,texture and cost.

avis.titre: I want to like this, but such a strong scent
avis.texte: I wanted to like this, but it had such a strong overpowering scent. Its also hard to wear underneath makeup bevause it tends to be pilling. As for fesults, I haveny used it long enough yet. Lots of reasearch to support it so hope it works

avis.titre: I want to like this, but such a strong scent
avis.texte: I wanted to like this, but it had such a strong overpowering scent. Its also hard to wear underneath makeup bevause it tends to be pilling. As for fesults, I haveny used it long enough yet. Lots of reasearch to support it so hope it works

avis.titre: It smelled good but my sensitive skin reacted to it
avis.texte: The texture is smooth and easy to blend. When a did a skin test to the product my skin liked it at first but about 24 hours I was breaking out pretty bad. The smell was nice. I really wanted to like this product but unfortunately my skin disagreed.
This serum smells good and goes on smoothly. I usually apply a moisturizer over my serum, after it dries, but, this product is like a serum with moisturizer. Good product. Would recommend.

avis.titre: Definitely help even out my skin tone
avis.texte: Definitely has helped reduce the signs of aging while also evening out my skin tone. Absolutely love it helps moisturize without feeling greasy.

It's super easy to apply, It's not sticky like some others. You start to feel it work as soon as you apply it. I use everyday but I can't really tell about working for my dark spots but it makes my skin feels soft and radiant.

my dermatologist gave me some samples and I like how it goes on easy and doesn't leave a residue. smell not bad, absorbs fast into skin. I use at night and apply my moisturizer on after. I will be purchasing the large bottle. I do have sensitive skin and it did not irritate.
I tried it for 2 weeks and ended up breaking out. Not for me.

Cool great fun awesome Completely a 5. Change in skin texture and tone within 5 days. I've used a pricey British skin care line for years and had issues with breaking out. Eucerin serum is 1/3 the price and much more effective.
This was a great and effective product. I saw that my skin felt moisturized and hydrated however I did feel like I have other moisturizers that I prefer.
A great serum for everyday use. Would definitely recommend to friends and family. Look forward to continuing to use after my free trial product is gone.
I enjoyed trying this product. I used it at night so that it could work wonders while sleeping. Haven't saw any results yet but will keep at it.
I received Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum free for review. The serum had a nice scent. It applied smoothly and did not leave a tacky feeling. It absorbed great into the skin.
I loved it so much, it left Mt skin feeling wonderful and has cleared up by 50 percent so it was better than I expected
The scent is very fresh and not overpowering. It has a nice light moisturizing texture. It feels very good when applied and it absorbs well.

i received this product for free in exchange for my honest review and overall i am happy with the results i am seeing from this serum for balancing out my skin tone and redness however i wish the scent of this product was a bit better
I'm sure it's a great product for other people but it was not for me.
I've only used this product for about a week, but I have started to see a slight difference already.

I'm so happy I can get this from Ulta now. Before it came to the state I used to get it directly from EU. It's such a potent product for hyperpigmentation and I would recommend it to everyone who doesn't want to use hydroquinone
I really enjoyed this product! It was easy to apply and I like the feel of it on my skin! So glad I got to sample it
Product goes on good, last for hours. I recommend putting it on at night
This serum is so hydrating and compliments my skin well. It is lightweight and doesn't clog my pores. It truly has helped my complexion and is a perfect part of my skincare routine.
The very best thing for dark spots. Really works..really works
I love this product. It smells subtle and fresh and it glides into the skin and doesn't leave me feeling greasy or sticky.

Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum I received this product free from PINCHme for my honest review and feedback, after using my skin looked more even and Radiant after using. I have not used continously daily to see the results in reducing dark spots.

I'm super inconsistent with having a skincare routine, but I was interested in trying this because I've never tried a serum before. I received this as a free sample via PinchMe. I have dark spots, and I've only used it a couple times, but I've seen instant results. Super light and easy to apply. This will definitely be part of my skincare whenever I decide to follow a regimen.
The fragrance in this is insane, which is a shame because otherwise I've been really liking it. Will not be repurchasing.

avis.titre: The fragrance is nauseating+irritated my eyes
avis.texte: Not for sensitive skin!!!!! I wish so bad that this didnt have that overbearing fragrance! The only product from this line that doesnt iritate my eyes is the radiant tone cleanser.

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I had high hopes for Eucerine Radiant Tone Dual Serum, in terms of hydration and reduction of dark spots. Unfortunately, this product was VERY drying and caused constant peeling of skin after a few days. I'm not typically someone who experiences irritation from skin care products, but this one caused full face redness for up to an hour after application. Overall, I wouldn't recommend this higher priced product with mediocre results.

Hello guys and gals! You all should DEFINITELY try this, Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum! You will surely, NOT regret it! I received this product, Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum, as a free, full sized sample. I've used it for almost 2 months now and noticed a difference in my skin. I felt like it made my skin tone more vibrant and radiant. At first, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of this product just because it was free but I WAS SO HAPPY TO FINALLY FIND SOMETHING THAT ACTUALLY WORKS! I will definitely be buying this, Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum from now on! I will also be telling everyone that I know about this product! I definitely recommend everyone try this. You will be amazed!
I received a free sample of Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum from PinchMe to try and review. It smells nice and goes on easy. My skin hasn't felt oily or greasy after applying which is nice.

I received this product for free from Secret and PinchMe in exchange for my honest review. I have been seeing good results after using this serum for the past couple of weeks. The serum is a lightweight lotion consistency that blends easily into my skin. It has a nice pleasant scent, and not only does my skin look brighter and more youthful, but it's much more hydrated from using this on a daily basis.
I really liked it although i feel the product am already using is more suitable for me. This is kinda oily I feel would be better for someone with dry skin but above all its a good product
I LOVE everything about this serum so far! It makes my skin look amazing!

Recently purchased this as it was on sale, I thought it would be a good choice to try since I have some slight post acne marks and a fee areas I'd like to brighten up. I can't say for sure if this serum works yet because I've only used it a couple times now but each time I do I get a tingling sensation all over my face that lasts around 5 minutes. I don't have sensitive skin so I'm not totally sold that this product is for me. Also, the fragrance of this serum is soooo strong, like straight up alcohol/Lysol disinfecting spray. I normally don't mind any fragrances in products I use but this serum fragrance is SO STRONG.

I am very pleased with this free sample from PinchMe. This serum has a pleasant, herbal smell. It goes on smoothly and makes my skin feel silky and soft. I've used it for a few nights and I'm already noticing a positive change in my skin tone.

I received Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual serum as a sample. After using it for almost a week I started to see some change in skin tone. It helped a bit to minimize some of the dark spots. And it helped even out the skin.
I like the texture but it is too early to see results, I have high hopes that it will work its suppose help with dark spots
